name: Regular City Council Meeting
agenda_text:
Regular City Council Meeting
CONSOLIDATED AGENDA
March 11, 2008
05:30 P.M.
CALL TO ORDER - City Council Chambers, 600 Eucalyptus Avenue, Vista, CA
ROLL CALL
PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE AND INVOCATION - Reverend Beth Johnson, Palomar Unitarian Universalist Fellowship
APPROVAL OF AGENDA
CLOSED SESSION
CS.
Reports on action taken in Closed Session
PRESENTATIONS
P1.
Proclamation to Beth Duncan, in recognition of being selected "Educator of the Year Award" for San Diego and Imperial Counties by the California League of Middle Schools and declaring March 12, 2008, "Beth Duncan Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P2.
Proclamation to Lettie Gibbs, award recipient of Employee of the Year and declaring March 13, 2008, "Lettie Gibbs Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P3.
Proclamation to Marilyn Anderson, award recipient of Manager of the Year and declaring March 14, 2008, "Marilyn Anderson Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P4.
Proclamation to Rosanne McElhaney, recipient of the Mayor’s Excellence-In-Service Award and declaring March 15, 2008, "Rosanne McElhaney Day" in the City of Vista. (CC)
P5.
Presentation by Yelena Feldman regarding the San Diego Workforce Partnership. (CC)
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS
CONSENT CALENDAR
C1.
Check Register (CC)
C2.
Ordinances on Agenda (CC)
C3.
Approval of Minutes (CC/CDC/BSD)
C4.
Second Reading of Ordinance (CC)
C5.
Special Event Banner Program for 2008 Calendar Year (CC)
C6.
Graffiti Reward Claim (CC)
C7.
No Parking Zone on W. Vista Way (CC)
C8.
Notice of Completion for the Traffic Signal Interconnect Phase III Project (CC)
C9.
Agreement with Poolscape Unlimited, Inc. (CC)
ITEMS REMOVED FROM CONSENT CALENDAR FOR DISCUSSION
DISCUSSION
D1.
W. California Avenue Improvement Project and Deferred Construction Contracts (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving the design of the W. California Avenue Street Improvement Project and authorizing bid advertising; and
2.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , demanding installation or construction of the public improvements on W. California Avenue.
D2.
City Council Goals 2007-2009 Update (CC)
PUBLIC HEARINGS - WILL BEGIN AT OR AFTER 6:00 P.M.
PH1.
Appeal of Planning Commission Approval of PC23-321 (Wal-Mart Expansion), Wal-Mart Stores, Inc., applicant (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving an Addendum to the Subsequent Program Environmental Impact Report for North County Square for a 28,122 square foot expansion to an existing commercial retail building at 1800 University Drive; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Site Plan Review (also known as a Plot Plan Review) for a maximum of 28,122 square-feet expansion to an existing commercial retail building and a Comprehensive Sign Program at 1800 University Drive.
PH2.
Central Vista Business Improvement District (CVBID) Proposed Assessments (CC)
1.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , confirming the 2008-2009 annual report for the CVBID, and levying the assessment for FY 2008-20098; and
2.
City Council Resolution No. 2008- , appointing the Advisory Board of the CVBID for the FY 2008-2009.
PH3.
Zoning Code Amendment for Commercial Outdoor Uses, City of Vista, applicant (CC)
1.
Adopt City Council Resolution No. 2008- , approving a Negative Declaration under CEQA for an amendment to Chapter 18.40 of the Development Code relating to commercial outdoor uses; and
2.
Introduce City Council Ordinance No. 2008- , entitled "An Ordinance of the Chartered City of Vista, California, Amending Chapter 18.40 of the Development Code Relating to Commercial Outdoor Uses."
REMARKS
R1.
Reports from members of the governing bodies on outside committee meetings.
R2.
Reports and comments from City officials and members of the governing bodies.
ADJOURNMENT
